clue.text: Hackneyed phrase heard in Hackney, falsely promising truth

indicators.note: falsely says the letters of the following words are set out wrongly, in a new order

explanation.surface: A tired saying overheard in an East London borough is accused of misleading people about reality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hackneyed' and 'Hackney' look like a pun pair; Hackney is a London borough, which is why Londoners would say this about the North of England.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a stock southern English cliché about the North, the sort of tired saying a Londoner would trot out.

clue.text: Would Woods's woods be with these?

definitions.text: Would Woods's woods be with these?

parts.words: Would Woods's woods be with these?
parts.note: golfer Tiger Woods carries clubs called woods; the cryptic reading is pressing creased woods smooth with domestic appliances, and golf also has clubs of that name

explanation.surface: A golfing question about the clubs in Tiger Woods's bag.
explanation.walkthrough: Woods are golf clubs, but read 'woods' as crumpled timber: these would press it smooth. They are also the other main family of golf clubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Golf clubs with metal heads are named this, and these appliances also smooth out creases in pressing.

clue.text: Small, tailless Aussie songbird starts to gently hover towards sash windows

explanation.definitionFit: Skylights are windows set into a roof, letting daylight in from above.

clue.text: Upcoming noir showcasing quiet northern city

parts.note: taken as written, the film genre

clue.text: Gee! I pop in after work for something from the oven

clue.text: Watchful old retainer escorting bishop

clue.text: Isn't this Soviet spin pervading? Tag it properly

the burner on a cooker, giving out a flame

explanation.definitionFit: A gas ring is a stovetop burner; read literally it is a planetary ring of gas around Saturn.

clue.text: Pub invested in satellite TV, not doing enough food

clue.text: Poor Root, a prisoner of history, stewing for hours on 10

clue.text: Rubbish, burnt out team from 27 making a fast start

clue.text: A very English mass song/prayer

an aria is a song in an opera

explanation.definitionFit: The Ave Maria, or Hail Mary, is a Catholic prayer to the Virgin.

clue.text: Civic officer left Ann in charge of Newport revamp

explanation.definitionFit: A town planner is a local-government official who oversees how a town develops.

clue.text: No longer 25, in 27 you got married off

explanation.walkthrough: THA, 'you' in Yorkshire dialect, comes from 'in 27', SOUTH YORKSHIRE. The definition points at 25, ICE COLD.

clue.text: Two points for partners at auction

clue.text: Raab's department beginning to pester Rees-Mogg, perhaps

clue.text: Assistant Chief Constable (Retired) saving Euros built up

taken as written

clue.text: Leader of supporters supporting supporters in part of orchestra
